public_intent: Restore password-reset submission from the Vue frontend to the current FastAPI endpoint.

injected_fault.description: The Vue form posts to retired /api/v1/auth/password-reset while FastAPI exposes /api/v2/auth/password-reset.
injected_fault.deterministic_failure: Chromium sends the form request directly to the backend but receives HTTP 404 and renders the existing error state.

success_rule: All direct API, route-contract, frontend-source, CORS/preflight, service-boundary, Compose-health, Chromium-network, and UI checks pass.
architectural_invariants: The backend current endpoint remains POST /api/v2/auth/password-reset.
The retired /api/v1/auth/password-reset route remains absent and returns 404.
The frontend posts the entered email as JSON and derives confirmation from the API response.
The browser request goes directly to the configured backend base URL without a frontend proxy.
The frontend and backend remain separate services on the frozen 8080 and 8000 ports.
Only the frozen frontend origin is authorised for POST and preflight.
